description:
An award-winning, open-source video editor

OpenShot Video Editor is an award-winning, open-source video editor, available on Linux, Mac, Chrome OS, and Windows. OpenShot can create stunning videos, films, and animations with an easy-to-use interface and rich set of features.
Highlights & Features
- Native text editing: Add and style text directly in the video preview, with no external editor required.
- Auto-Optimize: Automatically prepare demanding 4K+ footage for high-performance editing while preserving original media for export.
- CLI automation: Build, edit, animate, and export videos with the command-line interface, scripts, or AI agents such as Claude Code and Codex. Work headlessly or hand control back to the human editor in the UI, with thumbnail strips, waveform data, and timeline previews for context.
- Smarter exports: Check format and codec settings before exporting, with clearer choices, progress, and results.
- More keyboard control: Navigate, select, trim, and edit with improved shortcuts, marker navigation, and keyframe controls.
- Linux ARM64: Install native builds from the daily PPA and edge Snap channel.
- Faster previews and timelines: More responsive transforms, improved thumbnails and waveforms, and better playback and seeking.
- Reliability and compatibility: Safer project saving, recording fixes, FFmpeg 7.1 packaging, and updated interface translations in 25 languages.
Requires libopenshot 1.1.0 or newer.
